paragraphs: The stock price of Fermi Inc. is currently 6.07, representing a decrease of 3.42% from the prior close and 35.82% over the past 22 sessions. As of the current date, July 29, 2026, there has been one new news item in the last 24 hours.

Recent news includes a report from Stocktwits that Fermi Inc. announced the departure of CEO Toby Neugebauer as of April 17, 2026, and the establishment of an Interim Office of the CEO. This news was filed with the SEC and has contributed to the stock's recent movement.

There have been various SEC filings from Fermi Inc., including the appointment of new officers, the resignation of director Miles Everson, and the issuance of $431.25 million in convertible senior notes due 2031. Additionally, there has been one Form 4 filing and four new social posts in the last 24 hours, including discussions about Fermi America and a potential data campus development in Kentucky.
